description: List private non-binding Requests within the current approved scope. No arguments preserves the array of up to 100 most recently updated summaries. For bounded complete traversal, pass page={limit:5}; result then contains items, has_more and next_cursor. Continue with page={limit:5,...next_cursor}. Page limits are 1–20. Pages use immutable creation time and ID, newest first, so maintenance does not move records between pages. New records and grant changes require a fresh traversal; pages are not a single atomic snapshot. Scope filtering precedes the limit, and every page checks current authority. Fetch get_future_purchase for the full Request. Does not reaffirm interest.

page.description: Optional paging: limit, plus next_cursor from the previous page.

name: list_future_purchases

buyer_status.description: The one status the person sees, decided at as_of; the first that applies wins: closed, ended (past expires_at, or past its need_by date unless bought or an Offer is current), not_confirmed (a draft), paused (paused by the person; confirming it again counts it), bought (we saw a paid, uncancelled store order for this Request that wasn't fully refunded), offer_ready (a current Offer exists), details_needed (no confirmed exact item or delivery method, or only pickup while pickup is not arranged), confirm_needed (sellers no longer count it: unconfirmed for over 30 days; reaffirming with the user's say-so counts it again), asking_sellers (an RFQ counting this Request is open to sellers), no_offer (that RFQ ended and no Offer was made; it stays until sellers are asked again), offer_ended (an Offer was made and is no longer current, with no known purchase), gathering_interest. label is the words the person sees; show it as given.

test_data.description: True for a test account’s Request: never counted, and its Offers are samples.
